_note: EXAMPLE DATA, invented for this demo. Not from any real company or client.

corpus.d1: To reset your password open Settings, choose Security and press Reset password. A link is sent by email.
corpus.d2: Invoices are generated on the first day of each month and can be downloaded as PDF from the Billing page.
corpus.d3: You can cancel your subscription at any time from Billing. Access continues until the end of the paid period.
corpus.d4: Two-factor authentication uses an authenticator app. Backup codes are shown once when you enable it.
corpus.d5: Data export produces a CSV file of all records. Large exports are emailed as a download link.
corpus.d6: API tokens are created under Developer settings. Tokens can be revoked at any time and expire after 90 days.
corpus.d7: Support is available on weekdays from 9 to 18 in the Brazil time zone. Urgent incidents are handled on weekends.
corpus.d8: Team members are invited by email. Roles are admin, editor and viewer.
corpus.d9: Webhooks send a signed JSON request when a record changes. Failed deliveries are retried three times.
corpus.d10: Deleting your account removes personal data within 30 days. Backups are purged after 60 days.
